def f(): pass
print(*dir(f))

def f(): pass
print(*object.__dir__(f))

def f(): pass
f.tag=7
d=f.__dict__
a=dir(f)
b=dir(f)
a.append("only-copy")
print(a is b,"tag" in b,"only-copy" in b,list(d)==["tag"],d is f.__dict__)

def f(): pass
a=dir(f)
f.tag=7
b=dir(f)
f.tag=9
print("tag" in a,"tag" in b,len(dir(f))==len(b))
del f.tag
print("tag" in dir(f),"tag" in b)

def f(): pass
f.old=7
a=dir(f)
f.__dict__={"fresh":9}
b=dir(f)
print("old" in a,"old" in b,"fresh" in b,list(f.__dict__)==["fresh"])

def f(): pass
f.__dict__={"__name__":7,"__doc__":9,"__class__":11}
r=dir(f)
print(len(r),len([n for n in r if n=="__name__"]),f.__name__)

def f(): pass
key="__na"+"me__"
f.__dict__={key:7}
r=dir(f)
print([n for n in r if n=="__name__"][0] is key)

def f(): pass
key="ta"+"g"
f.__dict__={key:7}
r=dir(f)
print([n for n in r if n=="tag"][0] is key)

def f(): pass
f.__dir__=lambda: ["custom"]
print(f.__dir__()[0],"__code__" in dir(f),"__dir__" in dir(f))

def f(): pass
def custom():
 print("never")
 return []
f.__dir__=custom
r=object.__dir__(f)
print(r[0],"__code__" in r)

def f(): pass
m=f.__dir__
print(m.__name__,m.__qualname__,m.__self__ is f,type(m).__name__)
print(len(m()),"__code__" in m())

def f(): pass
m=object.__dir__.__get__(f)
print(m.__self__ is f,len(m()),object.__dir__.__objclass__ is object)

f=lambda:7
def g(): yield 9
f.tag=7
g.other=9
print("tag" in dir(f),"other" in dir(g),len(dir(f)),len(dir(g)))

class C:
 def read(self): return 7
f=C().read.__func__
f.tag=9
print("tag" in dir(f),len(dir(f)),f.__name__)

def f(): pass
f.__name__="renamed"
f.__qualname__="scope.name"
f.__doc__=[]
f.__module__=[]
print(len(dir(f)),len(f.__dict__),f.__name__)

def f(): pass
f.__dict__={7:9}
r=object.__dir__(f)
print(r[0],len(r),"__code__" in r)

def f(): pass
def values():
 yield dir(f)
 yield dir(f)
g=values()
a=next(g)
f.tag=7
b=next(g)
print("tag" in a,"tag" in b)

def f(): pass
object.__dir__(f,7)

def f(): pass
object.__dir__(self=f)

def f(): pass
dir(f,7)

def f(): pass
dir(object=f)

class C: pass
print("__dict__" in dir(C()))
print("__func__" in object.__dir__(staticmethod(lambda:7)))

class C: pass
print("get" in dir(C.__dict__))

def f(): pass
print("__func__" in dir(staticmethod(f)))

def f(): pass
r=dir(f)
f.__builtins__
